Each of the aforesaid shall be referred individually as a “Party” and collectively as “Parties”.

WHEREAS:
(A) TATA is directly and indirectly engaged in businesses in a wide array of industries;

(B) The Service Provider is engaged in the business of advertising Services;

(C) Based on the representations made by the Service Provider and mutual discussions of the
Parties, TATA is desirous of availing and the Service Provider is desirous of providing
the Services (as hereinafter defined) to TATA;

(D) Accordingly, the Parties are entering into this Agreement with a view to record the
agreement and arrangement reached between them in relation to rendering Services.

NOW THIS AGREEMENT WITNESSETH AND IT IS HEREBY AGREED AND
DECLARED BY AND BETWEEN THE PARTIES HERETO AS FOLLOWS

1, DEFINITION AND INTERPRETATION

| Definitions

In addition to the terms defined in the introduction to and the text of this Agreenent,
wherever used in this Agreement, unless repugnant to the meaning or context thereof, the
following words and terms shall have the meanings set out below:

“Agreement” means this Agreement, together with the Schedules and Annexures
attached hereto, each as may be amended from time to time;

“Arbitral Tribunal” has the meaning assigned to such term in Clause 12.3 hereto;

“Arbitral Tribunal Chairman” has the meaning assigned to such term in Clause 12.3
hereto;

“Confidential Information” of any Party shall include without limitation any and all

(in whole or in part) from the foregoing;

“Effective Date” means 1°' August 2022;

“Force Majeure Party” has the meaning assigned to such term in Clause 8.1 hereto;

“Intellectual Property” mean all (a) copyrights and copyrightable works and

1.2 Interpretation

In this Agreement:

(a) The descriptive headings of Clauses are inserted solely for convenience of
reference and are not intended as complete or accurate descriptions of content
thereof and shall not be used to interpret the provisions of this Agreement;

(b) The use of words in the singular or plural, or with a particular gender, shall not
limit the scope or exclude the application of any provision of this Agreement to
any Person or Persons or circumstances except as the context otherwise permits;

(c) The terms “hereof”, “herein”, “hereto”, “hereunder” or similar expressions used

. in this Agreement mean and refer to this Agreement and not to any particular
Clause of this Agreement. The terms “Clause” or “sub-clause” mean and refer to
the Clause or sub-clause of this Agreement;

(d) The recitals and schedules of this Agreement form an integral part of this
Agreement;

(e) Any reference to any statute or statutory provision shall include: (i) all

(f) No rule of construction or interpretation shall apply to the disadvantage or

2. PROVISION OF SERVICES

2.1 The Parties hereby agree that Service Provider shall, from the Effective Date, in terms of
this Agreement, render services to TATA in accordance with the details and timelines, as
more particularly set out in Schedule I hereto (“Services”).

2.2 In providing the Services, the Service Provider shall:

(a) take due care in providing the Services to TATA;

(b) comply with all applicable laws, regulations and guidelines in the provision of the
Services;

(c) ensure that the Services are provided efficiently, observing the highest standards,
in a professional manner and according to the terms and conditions of this
Agreement and as acceptable to the TATA; and

(d) comply with requests of TATA in relation to the provision of the Services as per
the terms of the Agreement.

. 2.3 The Service Provider further undertakes to provide such information in relation to the

Services and at such intervals as TATA may reasonably require.

2.4 Upon identifying or being notified by TATA of any problem with any of the Services, the
Service Provider shall initiate such investigative and remedial measures as are appropriate
to the satisfaction of TATA.

2.5 TATA and the Service Provider may from time to time with mutual agreement amend the

scope of the Services by amending Schedule I in accordance with the provisions of this
Agreement.

2.6 The Service Provider acknowledges that time is of essence for this Agreement and
undertakes to provide quality professional services in a timely manner.

2.7 Service Provider shall obtain, keep valid and subsisting, and comply with the conditions
of, all permits, licenses, authorizations and consents as may be required from time to time
in respect of and in relation to the performance of its obligations under this Agreement.

3. SERVICE FEE

3.1 In consideration of the Service Provider providing the Services, a fee as set out in
Schedule I (“Service Fee’’) shall be payable to the Service Provider.

3.2 All payments under this Agreement shall be subject to deduction of tax at source, if
applicable, as per prevailing laws. The Party deducting any tax at source pursuant to any

applicable law shall deliver to the other Party, TDS certificates in accordance with the

provisions of such law.

. 3.4 The payments due under this Agreement are expressed exclusive of Goods and Services

Tax that may be payable by reference to the Service Fee, and it shall be paid by the

Service Provider, subject to the same being marked separately in the invoice along with

all relevant GST registration details.

4, PROJECT MANAGER
4.1 TATA may assign a representative (‘TATA Manager”) for coordination with the
Service Provider Manager to review performance of this Agreement, resolutions of
problems and other activities to facilitate success of this Agreement.
4.2 TATA shall send written notice to the Service Provider 14 (fourteen) days in advance
; about change of TATA Manager at any time during the term of this Agreement.
5. TEAM STRUCTURE
5.1 The Team Structure of Crayons for providing the services as per the Scope of work to the
client is mentioned in the Schedule-III
6. REPRESENTATIONS AND WARRANTIES
6.1 The Service Provider represents and warrants to TATA that:

(a) it has the requisite rights, power and authority to provide the information,
specifications, data, work for hire and Services that it has or shall provide
pursuant to this Agreement and that possession and use of such information,
specifications, data, work for hire and Services shall, at no point in time, whether

. during or after expiry / termination of this Agreement, constitute an
infringement, or threaten infringement, of any patent, copyright, trade secret, or
any other Intellectual Property Right of any third party or give rise to any claims
of any nature on TATA by any third party;

(b) the execution and delivery of this Agreement by it, the performance by it of its
obligations hereunder and compliance by it with the provisions hereof will not

; violate, contravene or breach or create a default under any agreement,
instrument, charter or by-law provision, statute, regulation, judgment, ordinance,
decree, writ, injunction or applicable law;

(c) it has all necessary licenses, permits, approvals, consents and sanctions as may
be necessary or required from time to time under Applicable Law or regulation
or otherwise for performance by it of all its duties, obligations, Services and
responsibilities hereunder;

(d) it has the requisite experience, knowledge, expertise, capability, availability of
manpower and infrastructure necessary to effectively and properly provide the
Services to the satisfaction of TATA and that the Services provided under this
Agreement shall be performed with the highest degree of skill and judgment and

as per the good industry practice.

7. INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY

71 Each Party owns all right, title and interest in its respective Intellectual Property and
nothing in this Agreement shall be construed to create any right of ownership or any other
right or interest of any Party over the Intellectual Property of the other Party.

. 7.2 The Service Provider acknowledges and agrees that the Services are performed and
provided under this Agreement on a “work for hire” basis and TATA shall own all
Intellectual Property Rights contained in and with respect to the Services, including
without limitation, all modifications, adaptations, enhancements and/or derivative works
thereof, free from any lien or encumbrances (of any nature whatsoever). Service Provider
shall execute the necessary documents to solely and exclusively vest all the foregoing
rights in the Services with TATA..

73 The Service Provider undertakes that it shall not use any or otherwise any work product
resulting from the Services and/or Intellectual Property Rights of TATA in any manner
whatsoever for itself or for any client other than TATA, at any time.

, 74 Service Provider shall also, under no circumstances whatsoever, use any Intellectual
Property Right of TATA for any purpose other than providing Services to TATA.

7.5 Service Provider acknowledges and agrees that it shall not use TATA’s Intellectual
Property including its company name, trademarks, logos, patterns, advertising material
and product representations, know-how, in any country and for any reason whatsoever or
identify itself to be associated with TATA in any form or manner without prior written
permission of TATA.

8. FORCE MAJEURE

8.1 Neither Party shall be liable to the other Party for any delay or non-performance of its
obligations under this Agreement arising from any cause beyond its reasonable control
including any act of God, war, pandemic, epidemic, fire, flood, explosion, power
blackout, political unrest (a “Force Majeure Event”). The affected Party (‘Force
Majeure Party”) shall promptly notify the other Party (“Non-Force Majeure Party”)
orally or in writing, as the circumstances warrant, of the cause and the Force Majeure
Event and its likely duration. If performance as per the terms of this Agreement is not
resumed within 30 (Thirty) days after the Force Majeure Event, then the Non-Force
Majeure Party may terminate this Agreement at its sole discretion.

8.2 On the occurrence of any Force Majeure Event, both Parties shall use reasonable efforts
to perform the obligations under this Agreement during the period of suspension.

9. TERM AND TERMINATION

9.1 This Agreement shall be effective from the date of its execution and shall remain valid for
a period of | year, unless mutually extended by the Parties in writing or terminated earlier
pursuant to terms hereof (“Term”).

9.2 This Agreement may, however, be, terminated:

(a) upon mutual agreement of the Parties;
(b) in accordance with Clause 8 (Force Majeure)
(c) by TATA (in its sole discretion) by providing the Service Provider with written

notice of 30 (thirty) days;

(d) by TATA (in its sole discretion) if the Service Provider is in breach of its
obligations under this Agreement and which breach has not been remedied within
10 (ten) days of receipt of notice of such breach from TATA; or

(e) by TATA (in its sole discretion) if the Service Provider (i) is adjudicated
insolvent; (ii) makes a general assignment for the benefit of creditors; or (iii) has
a receiver or official liquidator appointed for the whole or any substantial part of
its assets and such appointment is not dismissed, reversed, vacated or stayed
within 60 (sixty) business days of such appointment.

9.3 Upon termination of this Agreement the Service Provider shall, within 2 (two) business
days from termination, return to TATA all Confidential Information of TATA in
possession of the Service Provider and any other materials without retaining, in whole or
in part, any copies, extracts or‘ other reproductions (whatever the form or storage
medium) of such materials. If TATA directs the destruction of the Confidential
Information, the Service Provider shall permanently destroy and remove all Confidential
Information including from any computer, disk or other device containing Confidential
Information and give in writing an undertaking to the effect that all the Confidential

, Information has been removed or destroyed. If any Confidential Information is unable to
be destroyed or returned, the confidentiality obligations under this Agreement for such
Confidential Information shall continue to be applicable.

9.4 The expiry or termination of this Agreement shall be without prejudice to any rights

which have already accrued to either of the Parties under this Agreement.
; 10. CONFIDENTIALITY

10.1 Each Party shall and shall use its reasonable efforts to ensure that its directors, officers,
managers, partners, members, employces, legal, financial and professional advisors, at all
times, keep confidential, (and shall ensure that its respective employees and agents keep
confidential) any Confidential Information which is in its possession or which it acquires
in relation to the other Party pursuant to this Agreement using at least the same degree of
care that it uses to protect its own,confidential or proprietary information, which shall be
no less than a reasonable degree of care and shall not use or disclose such Confidential
Information except (i) with the consent of such other Party; and (ii) for the purpose of this
Agreement.

10.2. Such obligation of each Party shall continue for a period of 2 (two) years after

, termination of this Agreement and each Party shall, keep confidential and will not
disclose, to third parties, the Confidential Information received from, or made available
by the other Party and will not use such Confidential Information for any purpose other
than the performance of its obligations under this Agreement.

However, the obligations and restrictions herein shall not apply to Confidential Information (a)

previously known to the receiving Party at the time of disclosure without breach of any

, confidentiality obligations, or (b) independently developed by the receiving Party without
reference to the Confidential Information, (c) disclosed to the receiving Party by a third party
without an obligation of confidentiality or (d) is or subsequently comes into the public domain

(other than as a result of a breach of this Agreement); (e) required to be disclosed by the receiving

Party by law, regulation, court order or other legal process.

If any Party is required by law to disclose any Confidential Information, the party
receiving notice will promptly notify the other Party of such request or requirement. If the

Party receiving notice is compelled to disclose the Confidential Information or else stand

liable for contempt or suffer other censure or significant legal penalty, that Party may
disclose only so much of the Confidential Information to the party compelling disclosure
as is required by the Applicable Law.

Each Party may at any time, at its sole discretion, require the other Party to discontinue
the usage of any or all Confidential Information and shall notify such Party of the same
(including in case of termination of this Agreement). In such case, the provisions of
Clause 9.3 shall apply.

. 11. GOVERNING LAW AND JURISDICTION
This Agreement shall be governed and interpreted by and construed in accordance with
the laws of India, without giving effect, if applicable, to the principles of conflict of laws,
thereof or there under and subject to the provisions of Clause 11, the Courts at Mumbai,
India shall have exclusive jurisdiction.

12, DISPUTE RESOLUTION ‘

12.1 Any dispute, controversy, claim or disagreement of any kind whatsoever between or
among the Parties in connection with or arising out of this Agreement or the breach,
termination or invalidity thereof (hereinafter referred to as a “Dispute”) shall at first

. instance be referred to the senior most representatives of the Parties for amicable
resolution. If the Dispute remains unresolved within 30 (Thirty) days of reference to the
senior most representatives of the Parties, then the same shall be referred to and finally
resolved by arbitration

12.2. Arbitration shall be conducted as per the Indian Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996,
which are deemed to be incorporated by reference into this Clause 12.2.

. 12.3. The number of arbitrators shall be three, one of whom shall be nominated by TATA, one
by the Service Provider and the third one of whom shall be appointed by the two
arbitrators appointed by TATA and the Service Provider respectively (“Arbitral
Tribunal Chairman”) and the said three arbitrators shall hereinafter collectively be
referred to as the “Arbitral Tribunal”.

12.4 The Parties shal! continue to perform their respective obligations under this Agreement to
the extent possible notwithstanding commencement of any proceedings in accordance
with this Clause 12. Such proceedings shall be conducted so as to cause the minimum
inconvenience to the performance by the Parties of such obligations.

12.5 The seat, or legal place and venue of arbitration shall be Mumbai, India and any award

shall always be treated as made at the seat of the arbitration. The language to be used in
the arbitral proceedings shall be English.

12.6 The decision of the Arbitral Tribunal shall be final and binding, shall be carried into effect
and may be made by an order of any competent court at the instance of any Party.

13. INDEMNITY

13.1 Notwithstanding anything to the contrary contained in this Agreement, the Service
Provider shall indemnify and hold TATA, its affiliates and their respective directors,
employees, representatives and agents (“Indemnified Parties”), harmless from and
against any claims, demands, loss, damage or expense suffered or incurred by the
Indemnified Parties as a result of (i) breach of representations and warranties made by the
Service Provider under this Agreement; (ii) breach of any obligation of the Service
Provider under this Agreement; and/or (iii) claims for infringement of Intellectual

14. LIMITATION OF LIABILITY

‘ 14.1 Neither Party shall be liable for indirect or consequential loss or damage, loss of profit,
goodwill, business opportunity or anticipated saving arising under or in connection with
this Agreement.

15. ASSIGNMENT AND SUB-CONTRACTING

15.1 The Service Provider shall not (in part or full) (i) assign its rights and obligations; and/or
(ii) sub-contract the performance of its obligations, under this Agreement without the
prior written consent of TATA. The Service Provider shall continue to be liable to TATA
for any sub-contracted or assigned work.

Agreement or by law does not constitute a waiver of that or any other right or remedy. No

; single or partial exercise of a right or remedy provided by this Agreement or by law shall
prevents a further exercise of the right or remedy or the exercise of any other right or
remedy.

16.3. Any notice or other communication to be given by one Party to any other Party under, or
in connection with, this Agreement shall be made in writing and signed by or on behalf of
the Party giving it. It shall be served by letter or facsimile or email transmission and shall
be deemed to be duly given or made when delivered (in the case of personal delivery), at
the time of transmission ((i) in the case of facsimile transmission, provided that the sender
has received a receipt indicating proper transmission and a hard copy of such notice or
communication is forthwith sent by prepaid post to the relevant address set out below; (ii)
in case of email, provided that the sender has received a successful sent receipt of email)
or 7 (seven) days after being dispatched in the post, postage prepaid, by the most efficient
form of mail available and by registered mail if available (in the case of a letter) to such
Party at its address or facsimile number or email specified below, or at such other address

16.5 Except as specifically provided, no person who is not a party to this Agreement shall be

16.6 This Agreement may be executed by the Parties in separate counterparts, each of which

16.10 The Service Provider hereby represents and warrants that it is familiar with applicable

of Conduct (see https://www.tata.com/about-us/tata-code-of-conduct)
